blocks.content: Quiz: What does "composition over inheritance" mean?
Tap an option below to answer:
Classes should always extend a parent class for shared behavior
That describes inheritance. Composition avoids extending parent classes in favor of combining smaller objects.
That describes inheritance. Composition avoids extending parent classes in favor of combining smaller objects.
Objects should contain instances of other classes instead of inheriting from them
Correct! Composition means building complex objects by combining simpler ones, keeping each class focused and independent.
Correct! Composition means building complex objects by combining simpler ones, keeping each class focused and independent.
Static methods should replace instance methods in every class
Static vs instance methods is a different concern. Composition is about how classes relate to each other, not method types.
Static vs instance methods is a different concern. Composition is about how classes relate to each other, not method types.
You should avoid using classes entirely and use plain objects instead
Classes are still useful. Composition is about how you connect classes - through "has a" relationships, not "is a" hierarchies.
Classes are still useful. Composition is about how you connect classes - through "has a" relationships, not "is a" hierarchies.
